episodes.title: Sonnie's Edge
episodes.summary: In the underground world of "beastie" fights, Sonnie is unbeatable -- as long as she keeps her edge.

episodes.title: Three Robots
episodes.summary: Long after the fall of humanity, three robots embark on a sightseeing tour of a post-apocalyptic city.

episodes.title: The Witness
episodes.summary: After seeing a brutal murder, a woman flees from the killer through the streets of a surreal city.

episodes.title: Suits
episodes.summary: A community of farmers use their homemade mechs to defend their families from an alien invasion.

episodes.title: Sucker of Souls
episodes.summary: Unleashed by an archaeological dig, a bloodthirsty demon battles a team of mercenaries armed with... cats?

episodes.title: When the Yogurt Took Over
episodes.summary: After scientists accidentally breed super-intelligent yogurt, it soon hungers for world domination.

episodes.title: Beyond the Aquila Rift
episodes.summary: Awakening after traveling light years off course, a ship's crew struggles to discover just how far they've come.

episodes.title: Good Hunting
episodes.summary: The son of a spirit hunter forges a bond with a shape-shifting huli jing.

episodes.title: The Dump
episodes.summary: Ugly Dave calls the garbage dump home, and he's not about to let some city slicker take it away from him.

episodes.title: Shape-Shifters
episodes.summary: Deep in Afghanistan, two Marines with supernatural powers face a threat from one of their own kind.

episodes.title: Helping Hand
episodes.summary: Stranded in orbit, an astronaut must choose between life and limb before her oxygen runs out.

episodes.title: Fish Night
episodes.summary: After their car breaks down in the desert, two salesmen take a dreamlike voyage to the dawn of time.

episodes.title: Lucky 13
episodes.summary: After the drop-ship Lucky 13 lost two crews, no pilot would fly her... but rookies don't get a choice.

episodes.title: Zima Blue
episodes.summary: The renowned artist Zima recounts his mysterious past and rise to fame before unveiling his final work.

episodes.title: Blindspot
episodes.summary: A gang of cyborg thieves stage a high-speed heist of a heavily armored convoy.

episodes.title: Ice Age
episodes.summary: A young couple moves into an apartment and finds a lost civilization inside their antique freezer.

episodes.title: Alternate Histories
episodes.summary: Want to see Hitler die in a variety of comically fantastic ways? Now you can. Welcome to Multiversity!

episodes.title: The Secret War
episodes.summary: Elite units of the Red Army fight an unholy evil deep in the ancient forests of Siberia.

episodes.title: Automated Customer Service
episodes.summary: If your home-cleaning unit is attempting to murder you, please press 3.

episodes.title: Ice
episodes.summary: Two brothers far from home join genetically "modded" locals in a deadly race.

episodes.title: Pop Squad
episodes.summary: A cop charged with fighting the scourge of overpopulation is haunted by the human toll of his work.

episodes.title: Snow in the Desert
episodes.summary: Every bounty hunter in the galaxy wants a piece of Snow.

episodes.title: The Tall Grass
episodes.summary: During a journey across the prairie, a man becomes transfixed by distant, ghostly lights.

episodes.title: All Through the House
episodes.summary: On Christmas Eve, two kids tiptoe downstairs to catch a glimpse of Santa. A twisted tale for adults only.

episodes.title: Life Hutch
episodes.summary: After crash-landing on a craggy planet, a pilot makes his way to shelter, only to face a threat within.

episodes.title: The Drowned Giant
episodes.summary: The body of a colossal young man washes ashore and becomes an object of fascination for the locals.

episodes.title: Three Robots: Exit Strategies
episodes.summary: Three robots walk into the post-apocalypse… and take a whirlwind tour of humankind's last attempts to save itself.

episodes.title: Bad Travelling
episodes.summary: Release the Thanapod! A ship's crew member sailing an alien ocean strikes a deal with a ravenous monster of the deep.

episodes.title: The Very Pulse of the Machine
episodes.summary: When an exploratory mission to a Jovian moon ends in disaster, the lone survivor must begin a perilous but mind-expanding journey.

episodes.title: Night of the Mini Dead
episodes.summary: A bit of unholy cemetery sex ends badly, kicking off a worldwide zombie plague. It's the cutest apocalypse you'll ever see.

episodes.title: Kill Team Kill
episodes.summary: US Special Forces are trained to neutralize any threat — even a cybernetic killing machine created by the CIA. Their secret weapon? A sense of humor.

episodes.title: Swarm
episodes.summary: Two human scientists study the secrets of an ancient alien entity — but soon learn the horrible price of survival in a hostile universe.

episodes.title: Mason's Rats
episodes.summary: Welcome to the Ratpocalypse! Farmer Mason knows he has a real pest problem when they start shooting back. Bloody hell!

episodes.title: In Vaulted Halls Entombed
episodes.summary: Modern warfare meets elder gods. A special forces squad on a hostage rescue mission finds themselves trapped in a prison containing an age-old evil.

episodes.title: Jibaro
episodes.summary: A deaf knight and a siren of myth become entwined in a deadly dance. A fatal attraction infused with blood, death and treasure.

episodes.title: Can't Stop
episodes.summary: A unique take on the Red Hot Chili Peppers' legendary 2003 performance at Slane Castle, Ireland, with band members Anthony Kiedis, Flea, Chad Smith, and John Frusciante recreated as string-puppets.

episodes.title: Close Encounters of the Mini Kind
episodes.summary: Tiny terror is unleashed in this mini alien apocalypse using tilt-shift techniques that make the end of the world look almost cute.

episodes.title: Spider Rose
episodes.summary: On a remote asteroid mining operation, a grieving Mechanist gets a new companion and has a chance to avenge herself against the Shaper assassin who killed her husband.

episodes.title: 400 Boys
episodes.summary: In a post-apocalyptic city where warring gangs follow a bushido-like code of honor, a new gang, the 400 Boys, forces them to unite.

episodes.title: The Other Large Thing
episodes.summary: The story of a cat who plans world domination. Sanchez, as his puny human "pets" know him, is helped by a new robotic butler who can hack into the World Wide Web and is eager to help his new master.

episodes.title: Golgotha
episodes.summary: A conscientious vicar plays host to an emissary of an alien race who believes their messiah has been reborn on earth… as a dolphin.

episodes.title: The Screaming of the Tyrannosaur
episodes.summary: On a space station orbiting Jupiter, decadent aristocrats gather to witness a brutal contest of genetically modified gladiators — fierce combatants riding deadly, engineered dinosaurs.

episodes.title: How Zeke Got Religion
episodes.summary: B-17 Flying Fortress Liberty Belle has the oddest mission of World War Two: a journey into occupied France to bomb a church before the Nazis can raise an ancient evil.

episodes.title: Smart Appliances Stupid Owners
episodes.summary: From an angry toothbrush to an overworked smart shower head and an intelligent toilet, various household appliances divulge tales of bemusement, scorn, and wonder about their human owners.

episodes.title: For He Can Creep
episodes.summary: London, 1757. A poet confined to an insane asylum believes Satan wants him to write a verse that will end the world. And the only thing standing between him and the Prince of Darkness is his cat, Jeoffry.
